title: Herdr workspace created
description: HERDR-6: the reply to `POST /v1/herdr/sessions/{name}/workspaces {cwd, name?}`. A running session the host lists gets a new workspace, made as `herdr --session <name> workspace create --cwd <folder> [--label <name>] --no-focus`, so the computer's screen stays where it is (only a session with no workspace at all has Herdr focus its first). `cwd` was resolved and checked first: inside $HOME, not a private place, an existing folder. The session is now this device's selection; `workspace.pane` is the new workspace's first pane, which the client shows in its own view. `workspace.cwd` is where Herdr opened the shell. Native and web credentials. HERDR-11: the request may leave `cwd` out or empty (the home folder) and may name `launch`, a command that must equal one of `GET /v1/herdr/folders`'s `launchers` exactly (else `400 herdr_launch_not_allowed`, before anything is made). Then `launch` says whether it was typed into the new root pane - the text, then Enter, once the shell drew its prompt (`drawn`) or after four seconds - and nothing else is ever typed there. A launch that could not be typed leaves the workspace standing (`sent: false`, `reason`).
